_nota: Cambi di tassa turistica già decisi, con data ufficiale (pagina tourist-tax-changes-2027/). Una voce per cambio: luogo, slug della pagina del sito (vuoto se non c'è), data, cosa cambia, importo, fonte ufficiale (URL, HTTP, data del controllo). 'verifica' = elenco [slug, data]: verifica.py controlla che quella destinazione abbia davvero una tariffa (o un supplemento, o un cambio annunciato) che parte in quella data. Solo atti o pagine ufficiali: niente stampa. 'importo_breve' = cifra corta per la tabella in cima (stessi numeri di 'importo' e 'prima'). Voce con 'uma' (Visitax del Quintana Roo): 'importo', 'prima' e 'importo_breve' li scrive genera.py da dati/uma.json (2,50 × UMA dell'anno; finché l'INEGI non pubblica la UMA 2027 la voce dice la formula).

voci.cosa: The accommodation tax goes back to the 2% rate in the law, from 1% since 1 May 2026, because Presidential Decision 11263 sets 1% only until 31 December 2026.
voci.importo: 2% of the accommodation price excluding VAT
voci.riserva: This applies unless a new Presidential decision published in the Official Gazette changes the rate again.

fonte.titolo: Presidential Decision No. 11263, Official Gazette (Resmî Gazete) No. 33240, 1 May 2026

voci.cosa: New prefectural accommodation tax on hotels, ryokan, simple lodging and minpaku. In Ishigaki, Miyakojima, Nago, Motobu, Onna and Chatan, whose own municipal taxes start the same day, it is split between prefecture (0.8% up to ¥800) and municipality (1.2% up to ¥1,200): the total stays 2%.
voci.importo: 2% of the room-only price per person per night (rounded down to the nearest ¥1,000), up to ¥2,000

fonte.titolo: Okinawa Prefecture - 沖縄県宿泊税 (Okinawa accommodation tax): start date 1 February 2027, rate, cap, exemptions

voci.cosa: The Visitax for foreign visitors (Cancún, Tulum, Playa del Carmen, Cozumel, Isla Mujeres, Holbox) is 2.50 UMA by law, and the UMA changes every 1 February. INEGI publishes the 2027 UMA in January 2027; this page and the calculators update when it does.

fonte.titolo: Ley de Derechos del Estado de Quintana Roo, article 51-Octies (2.50 UMA), and INEGI, Unidad de Medida y Actualización

voci.cosa: Two new municipal accommodation taxes. In Wakkanai (Hokkaido) the town tax is added to the Hokkaido tax (¥100 to ¥500), so the total is ¥300 to ¥700. In Shirahama (Wakayama) children under 12 are exempt.
voci.importo: Wakkanai ¥200 per person per night (plus the Hokkaido tax); Shirahama ¥200 to ¥1,000 per person per night by price band
voci.prima: Hokkaido tax only in Wakkanai; no tax in Shirahama

fonte.titolo: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications - consent to the Wakkanai City accommodation tax (30 June 2026); Shirahama Town: consent of 30 September 2026 (001093325)

voci.cosa: The Welsh Visitor Levy starts in Cardiff, the first council in Wales to charge it. It applies to bookings made from 28 September 2026; one booking of 32 nights or more is not charged.
voci.importo: £1.30 per person per night (all ages); 75p per adult per night in shared hostel rooms, bunkhouses and tent pitches

fonte.titolo: Welsh Revenue Authority (gov.wales) - Check if your council charges the levy; Visitor Levy in Wales

voci.cosa: New general rates of the Catalan tax on stays (IEET). The surcharges of Castelldefels, Esplugues, L'Hospitalet, El Prat, Sabadell and Sant Cugat change on the same day (Sant Just Desvern keeps its October 2026 surcharge).
voci.importo: 5-star €6.00 (from €4.50), 4-star €2.40 (from €1.80), tourist flats €2.50 (from €1.75), other €1.20 (from €0.90), youth hostels €1.00 (from €0.80), per person per night

fonte.titolo: Agència Tributària de Catalunya - IEET rates (quota tributària)

voci.cosa: The Barcelona city surcharge goes up; it rises again to €7.00 on 1 April 2028. The Catalan rate for Barcelona from April 2027 is not yet in the official table.
voci.importo: City surcharge €6.00 per person per night (from €5.00), on top of the Catalan rate

fonte.titolo: Agència Tributària de Catalunya - IEET rates, table 'Barcelona ciutat i recàrrec municipal'

voci.cosa: The fixed ¥100/¥200 amounts are replaced by a percentage, the tax-free threshold rises from ¥10,000 to ¥13,000 per person per night, and simple lodging and minpaku are covered too. Ordinance passed on 27 March 2026, Minister's consent on 30 June 2026.
voci.importo: 3% of the room-only price per person per night, from ¥13,000

fonte.titolo: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Bureau of Taxation - 宿泊税の見直し (accommodation tax revision, from 1 April 2027)

voci.luogo: Tomakomai, Yamagata, Fujiyoshida, Fujikawaguchiko, Unzen, Kagoshima and Ibusuki (Japan)
voci.cosa: Seven new municipal accommodation taxes on the same day, including the two Mount Fuji towns of Fujiyoshida and Fujikawaguchiko. In Tomakomai the 3% includes the Hokkaido tax.
voci.importo: Tomakomai and Yamagata 3% of the accommodation charge; Fujiyoshida, Fujikawaguchiko, Kagoshima and Ibusuki ¥200 per person per night; Unzen ¥100 below ¥5,000 and ¥350 from ¥5,000

fonte.titolo: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications - 法定外税の状況 (list as of 1 October 2026: start dates of approved accommodation taxes) and the Minister's consents of 30 June, 28 August and 30 September 2026

voci.cosa: New price bands for the Nagasaki City accommodation tax: the middle band now starts at ¥6,000 instead of ¥10,000 and rises from ¥200 to ¥300. Still no tax-free threshold.
voci.importo: ¥100 below ¥6,000, ¥300 from ¥6,000 to ¥19,999, ¥500 from ¥20,000, per person per night

fonte.titolo: Nagasaki City - 宿泊税 (rates until 31 March 2027 and from 1 April 2027)

voci.cosa: The Ortstaxe rises for the second year in a row.
voci.importo: 8% of the accommodation price excluding VAT and breakfast (from 5%)

voci.cosa: The federal fee paid by foreign cruise passengers on their first entry to Mexico goes up, as set by the decree of 30 June 2025 (paid in pesos at the Banco de México exchange rate). Re-entering on the same cruise stays free.
voci.importo: Peso equivalent of US$15 per foreign cruise passenger (until 31 July 2028, then US$21)

fonte.titolo: Decree granting tax incentives on migration fees (cruise passengers), DOF 30 June 2025 (SIDOF)

voci.cosa: New municipal accommodation tax in the city of the Hokkaido Ballpark F Village. The 3% is the total with the Hokkaido tax.
voci.importo: 3% of the accommodation charge (including the Hokkaido tax)
voci.prima: Hokkaido tax only (¥100 to ¥500 per person per night)

fonte.titolo: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications - consent to the Kitahiroshima City accommodation tax (3% of the accommodation charge), 30 June 2026

dopo.cosa: Accommodation tax €5.00 per person aged 18 or over per night (from €3.75); campsites €2.00 (from €1.50). Regulation of 26 November 2025, valid until 2031.
City surcharge €7.00 per person per night (from €6.00).
Federal fee for foreign cruise passengers: peso equivalent of US$21 (from US$15), until 30 September 2030 (decree of 30 June 2025).
Accommodation tax per person aged 18 or over per night rises to €2.05, €4.20 and €6.96 by category (from €1.96, €3.93 and €6.61), until 2031.
End of the reduced rates of the first three years: the Hakuba and Nagano amounts go up in every taxed price band.

non_elencati: Not listed because we could not read an official act with the date and amount: Venice's 2027 access fee calendar (the City's sites block automated reading), Milan's 2027 rates (not published when we last checked the City's site, on 10 October 2026), and the Catalan rate for Barcelona from April 2027. Oita Prefecture (Japan) has an approved accommodation tax of ¥100 to ¥2,000 per person per night, but its start date is only 'January 2027 or later': see the Japan accommodation tax 2027 page.
